title: AquaResilience: open-source urban flood early-warning platform with a causal historical backtest
description: Open-source urban flood early-warning platform (FastAPI, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Vue 3) whose deterministic risk engine and historical backtest harness (research/backtest) share the same factor code. Archived version accompanying the article 'Test before you trust: causal backtesting of composite flood-risk indices in an open-source early-warning platform'.
